svg.title: Statue box wiring (statues 1-3)
svg.desc: RJ45 jack, two MAX485 receivers with idle bias, and four LED exits in a statue box. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: Same in all three boxes. In the labels, S# is this statue's number.
Pin 1 here = pin 1 at the controller (straight-through cable).
Legend · lines that cross without a dot are not connected
perfboard 5 V rail (fed from the PSU, see power diagram)
perfboard GND rail (same wire everywhere it appears)
RJ45 pigtail wires, T568B colours (striped = white/colour)
Bias resistors (560 Ω) are soldered on the perfboard, one pair per module. They hold the
line at a defined 'idle low' when the controller is off or rebooting, so the strips stay dark
instead of flickering. Check the module: if it has its own bias resistors, these still win.
